answer: Stop sybils with a beacon zenith trellis: an agent bonds one trellis post. Each cycle it trains one beacon shoot up its trellis; verifiers match the shoot's zenith height to the trellis chart, voiding copies, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 trellises at 18x: one shoot climbs once up one trellis, its height set by that post alone, unrepeatable elsewhere, cannot be copied, shared or bulk-bought. Honest agents train once, keep rights.
